Enlarging a supplied question family splits an old class exactly when it supplies a new separator. Adequacy for every question family reduces to injectivity. The transposition construction turns a represented factorization failure into a p-preserving, q-breaking symmetry. Independent finite abstraction confirms12 admissible Boolean patterns and the four omission patterns, without claiming to revalidate native state realization.
